additionalInspection: Whole-wrapper concurrency prevents concurrent wrapper execution but does not wait for its dispatched central workflow.
The baseline selection does not verify that prior.head_sha is an ancestor of context.sha; a rerun of an older publication can compare against a newer successful queue.
The existing timestamp-only run-ID confirmation is not an immutable candidate identity check. Actual receipt acceptance remains separate and must inspect precise commit/manifest bindings.
